title: The unit of value may be a coordinated outcome
text: The Reshuffle note shifts attention from automating separate tasks to assembling them into a useful service. Reducing one task’s cost may move the bottleneck to integration, trust, demand or accountable delivery. This is a reason to measure the larger outcome as well as the local improvement.
qualification: Strategic framework, not proof that every workflow needs wholesale redesign or that predicted industry restructuring will occur.
